newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - AMEC still plans more minor sales.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - AMEC still plans more minor sales.

text.p: UK construction and engineering group AMEC Plc said on Thursday it still had further small disposals planned for 1997 as part of its internal shake-up.

Peter Mason, chief executive, said in an interview "We still have some more tidying to do on that front. They are not major disposals in comparison to the ones sold in 1996." He refused to cite which units AMEC has ear-marked in particular.
On the housing market, he said there was no sign that the UK election, set for May 1, had damped back demand in this sector.
"The first 12 weeks of the year have seen reservations move ahead, in the south (of England) particularly," said Mason.

In response to the issue of land price inflation, cited as a concern by some of the specialist house builders in recent weeks, he said there was no particular problem at present but added that there were strong regional variations and that it would have a damaging impact if it became more widespread and pronounced.
